title: Pan-Seared Vegan Tuscan Skillet
description: A flavorful vegan skillet dish made with tender vegetables and a hint of Tuscan seasonings, all cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add Tuscan kale and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
